title: The Truck
summary: The bay door is forced up an inch. Ray warns the truck crew has found them. The team barricades the dock with three pallets of water using the forklift. Ray reveals he heard the crew planning the robbery before the storm: a plow truck dug down to the dock while the roads were closed. Midway, the keypad by the bay door beeps from outside — someone is entering Dana's alarm code. The page with that code is missing from Ray's notebook, though he swears he never removed it. The door shudders again, pallets groan and begin to slide as the intruders push through. The crew faces a full breach.

end_card.hook: Can they turn the plow truck's own chain against the intruders?

continuity_out: Night 2 turning into Night 3, approximately three in the morning. Generator dead, store in total darkness lit by three flashlights. Bay door breached, pallets sliding, truck crew entering. Ray zip-tied but knows crawlspace and roof hatch. Dana has roof hatch key. Marcus has forklift and spotted chain on plow truck hitch. Crew (you, Dana, Marcus, Ray) together at loading dock. Truck crew (four men) forcing entry. Roads still closed, no police.
